findings.summary: Stale docstring: CompositeOwnerSource still says 'Production runs the dd owner and the line owner together … a decision note can name a dd development or a parked line', contradicting the R3/S11 deletion its own module header states. No behavioral surface (no OWNER_KIND_DD or DdOwnerSource anywhere in src/, grep-zero confirmed), but the prose misleads a future reader of the deleted second delivery path. Continuous finding, re-verified independently at final review.

Stale operator-facing help text: --dd-awaiting-gate still says a non-empty value 'makes the line self-deliver that single's gate decision — six mechanically produced evidence obligations, then decision_deliver'. Under R3 the wake anchor is only an input fact and the release travels exclusively through the gate node consuming dd.gate_release.v1; the code does exactly that (runner.py wires GraphGateNode; goal_line.py injects the fact), but the help documents the deleted decision_deliver path as the mechanism.

Stale field comment of the same class: dd_awaiting_gate_development_id still says the woken line 'self-delivers that single's gate decision (six mechanically produced evidence obligations, then decision_deliver)'. The launcher only forwards the wake identity; the release path is the gate node. Prose only, no behavioral surface.

dispatched_by is normalized with strip() before freezing (DdControlPlane.create control_plane.py:877; gateway/parse-layer checks compare strip-side), so a whitespace-padded payload value reaches record.json trimmed rather than byte-verbatim. The M2 invariant is unaffected (equality checked consistently, empty-after-strip fails closed at two locks); '逐字透传' holds exactly only for already-trimmed line ids, which is the only form the line-identity check admits. Continuous finding, re-verified independently at final review.
